My engineering work connects nanoscale device fabrication with electrical measurement and computational interpretation.

## Nanofabrication and device integration

Research experience includes solid-state nanopore fabrication and characterization, heterogeneous membrane preparation, and integration of devices into experimental measurement systems.

[Multilayer nanopore research](projects/heterostructures.qmd)

## Instrumentation and automation

Controlled dielectric breakdown and electrical characterization link fabrication with data acquisition. Experimental automation supports repeatable procedures and organized measurement workflows.

[Instrumentation project](projects/instrumentation.qmd)

## Modeling and analysis

COMSOL finite-element simulations examine electric-field distributions. Signal processing, event-feature extraction, and supervised learning support comparisons across devices and experimental conditions.

[Computational methods](projects/modeling-ml.qmd)

## Semiconductor coursework

Graduate laboratory coursework provided exposure to compound semiconductor fabrication and device characterization. This preparation is distinct from my hands-on research in nanopore fabrication.
